item.title: November 2026 Festivals in Seoul, Gyeonggi and Incheon
item.description: Festivals in the Seoul capital area for November 2026: Nowon Moonlight Walk, Namsan Night Festival, Seoul Cafe Show, a kimjang festival in Yeoju, Gyeonggi Rice Dessert Festa and the Incheon Airport Sky Festival, with dates, venues, fees, transport and highlights.

item.title: October 2026 Festivals in Seoul, Gyeonggi and Incheon
item.description: Festivals in the Seoul capital area for the rest of October 2026: silver grass at Haneul Park, Hanseong Baekje Festival, Jeongdong Night Walk, Icheon Rice Festival, Yeoju Ogok Naru Festival and more, with dates, venues, fees, transport and highlights.
